payload.artist_html: J. D. Daza, E. G. Selling, K. M. Jenkins, E. L. Stanley, D. S. Doucet, G. Fotanarrosa & A. M. Bauer
payload.credit_html: "Evidence of male anatomy in a mid-Cretaceous Burmese miniaturised amber gecko"
payload.description_html: Skeletal and appendicular remains of Carinasquama rusmithii A–D. Preserved portion of the skull of the paratype (HMNS.PB.729) in A, B. Lateral; C. Medial; D. Ventral views; E–G. Appendicular remains of paratype: E. Left manus, dorsal view: F. Right hind-limb, dorsal view; G. Left hind-limb, ventral view. H–J. Appendicular remains of holotype (NMS G.2022.2.1): H. Right fore-limb, dorsal view (metacarpals in light blue); I. Right hind-limb, dorsal view; J. Left pes, dorsal view. Large scale bar applies to A–D, small scale bar applies to E–J and E–J are at the same scale. Abbreviations: a-c lp, lateral process of astragalocalcaneum, dt3, distal tarsal 3, dt4, distal tarsal 4, mtV, metatarsal V.
